findings.description: The missing-CA-bundle check now emits a warning instead of raising OSError, so a nonexistent verify path or certifi path no longer fails fast with the intended clear error.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a caller passes verify='/nonexistent/ca.pem' (or the bundle path is missing). Before, cert_loc failed os.path.exists and OSError was raised with a clear message. Now warnings.warn is called and execution continues with a bad path, so the failure surfaces later from the TLS layer with a less clear error, or the warning is silently ignored. The commit title only announces removing the extraction call, not changing this error path to a warning, so the change is not covered by the stated intent.
